# Bounce (`bounce`)

A logo glides from edge to edge, changing color at every bounce — wait for the perfect corner.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: light (~1.3 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Bounce

## Params

| key | label | kind | range / options | default |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `speed` | Speed | slider | 0.2 … 3 | 1 |
| `size` | Logo Size | slider | 0.08 … 0.5 | 0.24 |
| `color` | Color | menu | 0 Shift on Bounce · 1 Rainbow · 2 Fixed · 3 Original Colors | 0 (Shift on Bounce) |
| `flourish` | Corner Flourish | toggle | 0 / 1 | on |
| `trail` | Trail | slider | 0 … 1 | 0 |

## Colours

| slot | label | default |
|---|---|---|
| `colorA` | Background | {"r":0,"g":0,"b":0} |
| `colorB` | Fixed Color | {"r":0.36,"g":0.62,"b":1} |
